a:r.a:t: Glycogenin Starts a New Glycogen Chain

p:cNvPr.descr: In image (a) top left, there is a pink box with a heaxagon that has a thick blck line on the bottom three sides. From the left point, clockwise: H binds down to HO; CH2OH binds down to H (inside hexagon); the third point is O; and H binds down to O. There is a red wavy arrow pointing to the line between H and O here. Glycogenin in a blue oval binds to a hexagon identified as Tyr194 with double bonds on the left, right, and bottom of the hexagon. It then binds left to HO. The O here has to red dots above it. The O on the 4th point of the hexagon inside the pink box, also binds down to P. P is in a blue box below, and binds left to -O, double binds down to O, and binds right to O, which binds right to P. P binds right to O-, double binds up to O, and binds down to O, which binds right to ribose, which binds right to uracil. The fifth point of the nexagon in red has H (inside hexagon) binding down to HO. The sixth point has OH (inside hexagon) down to H. Below the blue box is an arrow pointng down, with a smaller arrow jetting to the right to a blue box with UDP. Above that, it states, "glucosyltransferase activity" (in blue). UDP-glucose also joins the arrow going down on the left. The arrow points to another pink box just like the one above, except the fourth point of the hexagon, which binds right to O, which binds right a blank hexagon with the top left, right, and bottom showing double bonds. This binds right to an empty blue oval. The HO on the first point of the hexagon has two red dots below it with an arrow pointing to another image, which is exactly like the pink and blue boxes described above, only it is not in any colored boxes. From this image, there is an arrow, with "chain-extending activity" in blue, and has an arrow jarting to the right to UDP. At the bottom of the arrow, it states, "Repeats six times."
